about: Intake-gate specs for the everyday-language queries in retrieval_queries_casual.json, generated by eval/gate_specs.py. Used by `python -m eval.retrieval --queries gate`.

s01.query: I need a little tube to hold a 6mm bolt about one pinkie finger width off the wall.
s01.spec: A wall-mount standoff bracket designed to hold an M6 bolt 15 mm off a wall surface. It consists of a rectangular mounting base flange (36 mm long, 16 mm wide, 4 mm thick) with two 4 mm diameter countersunk holes spaced 26 mm apart for wall screws. Extending perpendicularly from the center of the base flange is a cylindrical standoff tube with an outer diameter of 14 mm and height of 15 mm. A central clearance hole of 6.5 mm diameter runs entirely through the cylindrical tube and base flange to accept a 6 mm bolt.

s02.query: A 25mm cube I can thread onto a 10mm rod.
s02.spec: A 25mm x 25mm x 25mm cube with a central M10 x 1.5 threaded through-hole aligned along the Z-axis (passing through top and bottom faces). All outer edges feature a 0.5mm chamfer, and the entrance/exit of the threaded hole are chamfered by 0.5mm.

s03.query: A six-sided chunk like a fat pencil cross-section, 30mm wide and 8mm thick.
s03.spec: A regular hexagonal prism (6-sided cross-section like a pencil) with a width across flats of 30 mm and a height/thickness of 8 mm.

s04.query: A flat bar about 70 by 20 with a long cutout down the middle, so a bolt can slide along it to adjust things.
s04.spec: A flat rectangular adjustment bar measuring 70 mm long, 20 mm wide, and 5 mm thick. A central longitudinal slot 6.5 mm wide (suitable for an M6 clearance fit) and 50 mm long (leaving 10 mm solid material at each end) extends through the full thickness of the bar. The four outer vertical corners are rounded with a 2 mm radius fillet.

s05.query: Something shaped like a little traffic cone, 40mm across the bottom and 30mm high, solid.
s05.spec: A solid miniature traffic cone with a overall height of 30 mm and base footprint width of 40 mm. The base is a square plate measuring 40 mm x 40 mm in plan view and 4 mm in height, with 4 mm fillets on the four vertical corners. Centered on top of the base plate, a conical section rises 26 mm (reaching total height 30 mm), tapering smoothly from a bottom diameter of 30 mm at the top of the base plate to a top diameter of 8 mm with a flat top surface. The part is fully solid.

m01.query: A backing plate to mount a circuit board on, 120 by 80, with six screw holes in two rows and soft corners.
m01.spec: A rectangular backing plate for mounting a circuit board, measuring 120 mm along X, 80 mm along Y, and 3 mm in thickness. The four outer vertical corners are rounded with a 6 mm fillet radius. The plate features six 3.5 mm diameter through-holes arranged in two rows of three holes each (3x2 grid). The two rows are spaced 60 mm apart in Y (10 mm inset from the top/bottom 120 mm edges). Within each row, the three holes are spaced 45 mm apart along X (at X = -45 mm, 0 mm, and +45 mm relative to the plate center, giving a 15 mm inset from the left/right 80 mm edges).

m02.query: A tray for sorting screws, about 100 by 60 and 15 deep, split into two sections.
m02.spec: A rectangular screw sorting tray measuring 100 mm in length, 60 mm in width, and 15 mm in total height. The outer perimeter walls and bottom base are 2 mm thick, giving an interior cavity depth of 13 mm. A 2 mm thick divider runs across the short axis (at X = 50 mm), splitting the tray into two equal compartments, each approximately 47 mm by 56 mm internally. The internal bottom edges and vertical corners of both compartments have a 3 mm fillet to make scooping out screws easy. Top outer edges have a 0.5 mm chamfer.

m03.query: A cap to put on a volume-control shaft, 30mm round; the shaft has one flat side.
m03.spec: A cylindrical volume control knob cap with an outer diameter of 30 mm and a total height of 15 mm. The top edge has a 1 mm x 45-degree chamfer. On the top face, a 1.5 mm wide, 0.8 mm deep indicator line extends radially from the center to the outer edge. The bottom face features a centered blind D-shaft hole with a 6 mm nominal diameter, a flat section reducing the shaft thickness to 4.5 mm (1.5 mm flat cut depth), and a total hole depth of 10 mm for press-fitting onto the shaft.

m04.query: A round plate 60mm across with a big hole in the middle and eight small screw holes around it.
m04.spec: A circular plate with an outer diameter of 60 mm and a thickness of 5 mm. It features a central through-hole with a diameter of 20 mm. Surrounding the central hole are eight 3.5 mm diameter through-holes, evenly spaced at 45-degree intervals along a 42 mm diameter bolt circle.

m05.query: Something to keep six cables lined up neatly along the edge of my desk.
m05.spec: A 6-slot cable organizer designed to clip onto the edge of a desk. Overall dimensions: 75 mm long, 35 mm deep, 30 mm high. It features a C-shaped clip profile with a 19 mm high opening and 25 mm grip depth to push onto the desk edge. The top section contains 6 evenly spaced cable slots (10 mm center-to-center spacing). Each slot consists of a 5 mm diameter circular cable channel with a 3 mm top entry gap for snapping cables in and out. All outer edges and slot entrances feature 2 mm fillets.

m06.query: A long open trough, 100mm long, 30 wide and 20 tall, open on top and at both ends, for routing wires.
m06.spec: A U-shaped open wire routing trough with an overall length of 100 mm, overall width of 30 mm, and overall height of 20 mm. The channel is open at both longitudinal ends and at the top. Wall thickness for the sides and bottom is 2 mm, resulting in an interior channel width of 26 mm and interior depth of 18 mm. Includes two 4.2 mm diameter mounting holes through the bottom floor along the center axis, spaced 60 mm apart (20 mm from each end).

m07.query: A cup about 50mm wide and 60 tall with a smooth rounded edge at the bottom.
m07.spec: A cylindrical cup with an outer diameter of 50 mm and an overall height of 60 mm. The wall thickness is 2.5 mm (inner diameter 45 mm) and the bottom base thickness is 3 mm (inner depth 57 mm). The outer bottom edge features a smooth fillet with a radius of 5 mm. The upper rim has a small 1 mm fillet on both inner and outer edges for a comfortable lip.

m08.query: A ring that clips around a 32mm pipe, with a small gap so it can flex open.
m08.spec: A C-clip style retaining ring designed to snap around a 32 mm outer diameter pipe. Inner diameter is 32 mm, outer diameter is 38 mm (3 mm wall thickness), and height along the cylinder axis is 15 mm. A 12 mm wide straight gap is cut through one side to allow the ring to flex open and snap onto the pipe. The lead-in corners at the gap opening and outer edges have a 1 mm fillet for smooth attachment.

h01.query: A cog with 20 teeth that fits on a 5mm shaft.
h01.spec: Spur gear with 20 teeth and a 5mm central bore. Module = 1.0 mm, giving a pitch diameter of 20 mm, outer (tip) diameter of 22 mm, and root diameter of 17.5 mm. Involute tooth profile with 20-degree pressure angle. Gear face thickness is 6 mm. Includes a central cylindrical hub extending from one face with a diameter of 12 mm and length of 6 mm (total thickness 12 mm). Central bore diameter is 5.0 mm through the entire height. Features an M3 set screw hole (2.5 mm diameter) drilled radially through the hub wall to secure to the shaft.

h02.query: Something to prop my phone up on the desk at a comfortable angle while I watch videos.
h02.spec: A desktop phone stand angled at 60 degrees from horizontal for comfortable video viewing. Overall dimensions: 70 mm wide, 80 mm deep, and 85 mm high. Features a 15 mm wide front shelf with an 18 mm high retaining lip to hold a phone with a case. Includes a central 20 mm wide cutout along the bottom shelf and backrest to allow a charging cable to pass through. Main support wall thickness is 5 mm, with rounded edges (2 mm fillet) on top and side corners for comfort.

h03.query: A thing I can screw to the wall to hang my headphones on.
h03.spec: A wall-mounted headphone hanger consisting of a vertical backplate and a forward-projecting curved support arm with a front lip. Backplate: 40 mm wide, 70 mm tall, 6 mm thick, with two countersunk screw holes (4.5 mm inner diameter, 9 mm countersink diameter for M4 screws) spaced 45 mm apart vertically along the centerline. Support Arm: extends 85 mm forward from near the top of the backplate, 38 mm wide, with a comfortable slightly concave surface to cradle a headphone headband. Front Lip: rises 15 mm at a 60-degree angle at the tip to prevent headphones from sliding off. A prominent 15 mm radius fillet underneath the arm reinforces the junction between the arm and the backplate. All exposed top and front edges are rounded with a 3 mm fillet.

p01.query: Make me a 15cm ruler that says ALEX on it.
p01.spec: A 150 mm measuring ruler (overall body dimensions: 160 mm long, 25 mm wide, 2 mm thick). The top face features a 150 mm scale along one long edge starting 5 mm from the end. Tick marks are debossed 0.4 mm deep: 1 mm interval ticks (1.5 mm long), 5 mm interval ticks (3 mm long), and 10 mm interval ticks (4.5 mm long). Centered text 'ALEX' is debossed 0.5 mm deep on the lower half of the ruler face with a 8 mm font height. The four outer vertical corners have a 2 mm radius fillet.

p02.query: A dice with pictures of snakes and ladders instead of dots.
p02.spec: A 20mm x 20mm x 20mm 6-sided gaming die with 1.5mm filleted edges. Each face features simplified 2D geometric icon engravings recessed by 0.8mm: Face 1 has a single ladder icon; Face 2 has a single S-curved snake icon; Face 3 has 2 ladders; Face 4 has 2 snakes; Face 5 has 3 ladders; Face 6 has 3 snakes. Opposite faces sum to 7 count-wise (1 vs 6, 2 vs 5, 3 vs 4).

p03.query: A little kitty sitting up in a tree.
p03.spec: Out of scope request: organic sculpted shapes (a kitty and a tree) cannot be accurately represented as a single mechanical parametric CAD model.
